items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: Henry Ragus. ... INTERVIEWEE: No, that looks like Henry Ragus. I think that's before he went up with the Dixieland.

ctx.x: It says here Herman Ragus. Is that any relation to the piano player?
Henry was a piano player at the original Dixieland Shields.
